selfReview.type: AI own-locale direct Japanese comparison and continuous Khmer prose self-review
selfReview.method: Read the complete effective Japanese packet. Translate all paragraphs, headings, lesson metadata and seven questions directly. Compare every meaning-bearing field with Japanese, then read the connected Khmer explanations, options and specific rationales for natural syntax and adult respect. Recheck actors, recipients, conditions, uncertainty, negation, timing, numbers and clinical limits. Validate every fixed binding and exact empty-reading semantics after wording corrections.
semanticChecks: Reserve checks preserve possession versus actual usability, compatible batteries/power, actual facility inspection method, storage-location knowledge, cash/document support purpose and restricted access. Individual mobility/hearing-aid/daily-care/medication needs are checked with the person and assigned staff. Expired or incompatible items are not counted as usable; uninspected items remain unconfirmed. Missing/unusable reasons, replenishment owner and next check are retained. Radio incompatibility and unconfirmed personal supplies are separate. No universal stock type/quantity or independent medication type/dose change is inferred; facility response plan and medical/assigned consultation retained.

Body directions use the care recipient rather than the facing worker as reference. Ascending colon normally on the person’s right going upward, transverse across, descending on the left downward; learning route right-lower to right-upper to left to left-lower preserved. Diagram orientation is not pressure strength, duration, frequency or permission to perform a procedure. Pain location/onset/person’s words go explicitly to medical staff or the instruction supervisor; no diagram-only cause judgment or force on abdomen. Pregnancy, inflammatory bowel disease, abdominal surgery/wounds remain important consultation conditions without independently deciding suitability. Scope is direction and terminology.

Scrotum as outer sac, testes as glands within, and foreskin covering the glans at the penile tip remain distinct. Unclear anatomical target/action must be checked; no inferred pulling direction/force or action from similar names. Do not start the unconfirmed action; check with instruction supervisor or medical staff. Pain/resistance means no forced continuation and communicate the condition. Privacy/shame, unnecessary public exposure, unrelated disclosure and necessary recipients retained. Confirmed body part, person’s words and unknown instructions remain separate. Source male wiping motion is explicitly not established here as safe technique; individual hygiene procedure requires professional guidance and facility method.

QOL includes satisfaction, happiness, meaning in life and inner richness, not staff task count alone. Person’s expressed evaluation is not replaced by worker preference/satisfaction. Physical task independence and choosing/deciding remain distinct; need for hand assistance does not remove possible choice of activity/time/own role. Photo-count paragraph and album-count question retain their different units. Desired reminiscence time is separate from output count. Record current wishes/difficult parts to the team and review wishes, abilities and safety rather than inflate activity count. No diagnosis from one answer/count and no unilateral care-plan change.

Community participation includes expressing wishes and choosing the method, not mere presence in a common place. Receiving care does not prevent contribution through experience/strengths and desired roles. Discuss actual barriers and needed support; neither impose one method nor exclude solely for difficulty. Audio-book example retains wish to introduce its content and the barrier from restricting presentation to independent print readers. Ask preferred presentation method and preparation/progression. Not every activity suits everybody; actual wishes/abilities/support/place/management conditions are checked with the person and assigned staff.

Service classification preserves who travels and where support/living occur: staff visit the home, person attends a facility/day service, or person lives in a residential facility. Vehicle/staff presence alone is insufficient. Return home versus residence is checked. Actual handover identifies person/date/time/place/support and separates undecided items; category name does not establish a schedule. Classification is not determination of individual eligibility, insurance benefits, fees or facility choice; actual coordination confirms wishes and consults assigned staff/care manager.

Care plan connects desired life, concrete goals and support. Implementation records staff actions; person’s reactions/results inform progress toward goals. Three invitations are not proof the person understood and chose. Afternoon-choice example preserves no fact of understood selection, and question preserves the uncomprehending statement on every occasion. Review information adequacy, explanation/participation conditions and goal suitability with the team; no blame for insufficient personal effort. Evaluation serves suitable support, not increased scores/counts. Separate actions/reactions/unknowns and share with the person and assigned staff. Actual goal/assistance changes require consultation, not unilateral decisions.

All7 explicit empty Japanese readings are represented by exact target reading:"". No omitted or invented full reading. All7 lesson contexts and art captions retain their teaching restrictions, including art not proving colon location/massage or genital washing/movement. No figure-caption keys exist in this packet.
